description: Search StubHub events by keyword, or browse by category. No login or proxy required.

activeListingsOnly.description: Only include events that currently have active ticket listings (excludes sold-out / no-tickets-available events).
activeListingsOnly.title: Active listings only

category.description: Event category (mode=byCategory, required; mode=search, optional filter).
category.title: Category

confirmedDateOnly.description: Only include events whose date is confirmed (excludes TBD-date events).
confirmedDateOnly.title: Confirmed dates only

country.description: Filter results to a specific country, e.g. `US` or `CA`. Records missing country data are not excluded.
country.title: Country (2-letter code)

dateFrom.description: Only include events on/after this UTC datetime, e.g. `2026-08-01T00:00:00+00:00`. Records without a resolvable event datetime are not excluded.
dateFrom.title: Event date from (ISO 8601)

dateTo.description: Only include events on/before this UTC datetime. Records without a resolvable event datetime are not excluded.
dateTo.title: Event date to (ISO 8601)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Note: StubHub's search endpoint returns up to ~20 results per keyword query (an upstream page-level limit).
maxItems.title: Max items

searchQuery.description: Free-text query — artist, team, venue, or event name (mode=search, required; mode=byCategory, optional refinement).
searchQuery.title: Search query

title: StubHub Scraper Input
